# React

Follow `stacks/react/AGENTS.template.md` and `.agents/skills/react-frontend/SKILL.md`.

- Function components. Follow the framework already in `package.json`.
- Compute derived values during render. Use an effect only to synchronize with an external system.
- Test behavior with React Testing Library. Check visible flows with Playwright.
- Do not add a second server-state library.
